item.title: Hello World
item.description:
Welcome! I’m starting this blog to document my journey through cybersecurity, hands-on learning, and technical projects.

Why Start This Blog?
#

It is often said that the best way to truly master a topic is to write about it and break it down. As I work through hands-on labs, certifications, and personal projects, this space will serve as both a public notebook for my own learning and a resource for anyone following a similar path.
